svg.aria-label: BlendPro as a bench machine. A teleprinter (the LLM agent) punches a narrow tape of compact JSON that runs on guides into a sorter cabinet (the BlendPro MCP server) carrying a lens unit (MediaPipe pose) and an aerial (Tripo3D API). One socket cable runs to a drawer cabinet (Blender with the add-on): a hopper on top is the single main-thread queue, a crank drains it one command at a time, and six drawers are the handlers. Results return along the front rail as small printed cards: text, not screenshots.
